title: The records attributed both start timeouts to the mechanism #446 removed, although the PostgreSQL one waits on the worker's local journal
resolution: proposal.md and verification.md separate the two: the broker start-recorded timeout's attribution to #446 is a hypothesis; the PostgreSQL start-journaled timeout, written by execution-watch.ts independently of the control plane, is recorded as unreproduced and unexplained.

title: The parallel-run counts said 10 passing and 5 failed runs, but the saved logs show 11 and 4
resolution: verification.md records 11 of 15 runs passing and 4 failed runs with 5 Toxiproxy-lock timeouts, naming the logs, as dev-par/summary.txt and the logs show.

title: The fail-before claimed to reproduce the failure every time from one recorded base run
resolution: Five more base runs at seed 1948878807 each failed with the assertion; the records say six of six base runs reproduced it, that the delay makes the late start likely, not certain, and keep deterministic only for the hold and release order.

title: The heal-before-the-exit branch released the held process before the worker reconnected, so its exit was journaled offline as in the other branch
resolution: After the heal the branch waits for the worker's latest contact record to be worker.contact.online, then releases. Fail-before at seed 3: a copy asserting online at the release failed 3 of 3 runs (actual 'worker.contact.offline'), passing 3 of 3 with the wait. design.md corrected.

title: The finally block did not release the held process before the worker's stop
resolution: The finally releases the scripted processes before worker.stop(), as cancellation race g does at test/g2-cancellation-races.test.ts:391; the cited :502 is a release in settleRace, not in a finally, so design.md cites :391 only.

title: The THEN of Exit while the worker is offline named an outbox publication that no assertion observes
resolution: The THEN states what the scenario asserts: the task stays pending until the heal, and after the heal the attempt exits once with one started execution. No duplicates assertion was added, as the duplicate count is not part of the contract. The archive probe passes strict validation.

title: verification.md cited worker-contact.ts:76-80 for the offline report, one line early
resolution: The citation is apps/worker/src/worker-contact.ts:77-81, the #lose method that logs worker.contact.offline.

title: tasks.md said 15 runs under a CPU hog, though they ran under 8 busy-loop processes
proposal.md merged the plain and the hog grant-to-cut ranges into 0.9 to 1.9 s
resolution: proposal.md states 0.93 to 1.03 s in plain runs and 1.56 to 1.86 s under 8 CPU hogs, as verification.md does.
